summary: Biofrontera Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing FDA approval of its supplemental New Drug Application for Ameluz (aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride) topical gel, 10%, combined with BF-RhodoLED photodynamic therapy, for treating superficial basal cell carcinoma in adults. No deal, stake, price, premium, or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine product-approval current report under Items 8.01 and 9.01, not a special situation. No structural or risk-arb angle applies; watch commercialization and label expansion only.
